nodes.label: file-host Daemon (serve directory over HTTP)
nodes.rationale: The server has no auth of its own, so it is reached through a public vestad route ($VESTAD_TUNNEL/agents/$AGENT_NAME/file-host/<filename>) rather than directly; on vesta the daemon start supplies the vestad-assigned port.

nodes.label: Public Means Public Rule
nodes.rationale: Anything in the served directory is reachable by anyone with the URL: never host secrets or sensitive personal documents unless the user explicitly asked to share that exact file, use unguessable filenames for anything personal, remove files once delivered, and stop the daemon when no longer needed.
